puṅgava.p: [ puma + gamu + a. Puma + go + a.padhāna-bhāvaṃ gacchatīti puṅgavo. Yadādi.dhāna,ṭī.696. ] (pu) Google Translate (1) Is it a pioneer cow? (2) Great. (The meaning of "great" because of the next verse in Samath. Dhan, Ky. 696.)""
